_comment: DEV/INTEGRATOR-console hooks, attached at launch via `claude --settings` (merges additively with user/project settings). This is console-hooks.settings.json PLUS the dev rails, so a LOCAL dev mission on ANY repo gets the same hard guard a Miss-Claude worktree gets from its checked-in .claude/settings.json (and a remote one gets from the shipped miss-rails.settings.json). Wired by console-session-wt.sh -> claude-miss and scripts/claude-miss-integrator, which export: $MISSWORK_HOOK (abs path to .claude/hooks/prevent-misswork.py — the HARD role guard), $MISSION_CONSOLE_SESSION (scripts/mission-console-session.py — SessionStart + UserPromptSubmit, records which transcript this console is writing so the context badge reads the right session), and $MISS_ROLE_CONTEXT (scripts/miss-role-context.py — SessionStart prints the role rules + YES phrases into context for repos whose CLAUDE.md doesn't carry them; it self-quiets in the mission-dashboard repo). $DOSKA_PROJECT_CONTEXT (scripts/doska-project-context.py — SessionStart prints the Doska Projects identity block; worktree = $MISS_WORKTREE, else the mission folder; UserPromptSubmit runs it with `prompt`, which re-sends the label once when the mission's display name changes) is guarded like the director hook. The PreToolUse command is deliberately UNguarded: if $MISSWORK_HOOK is unset/missing, python3 exits 2 and the tool call is BLOCKED — fail-closed, never silently unguarded. In a Miss-Claude worktree the guard also runs via the repo's .claude/settings.json (twice total) — harmless, the hook is read-only. The mission-doc nudge hooks (UserPromptSubmit reminder, PostToolUse milestone marker, Stop blocker) were REMOVED on 2026-09-07 at the operator's request — mission docs are now updated only when a session chooses to.
